genxml.title: texture engine and texture RAM registers of the Impact graphics subsystem
genxml.doc: Texture engine and texture RAM registers and loader registers of the Impact graphics subsystem.

struct.name: TEXMODE2
struct.doc: Texture mode for the drawn texture: component depth, filters, wrap and the no-border flag. The diagnostic's mask is 25 bits. The field positions are the client's encodings, graded per field; what the board does with each field is inferred. Bit 16 is set on every texture the client has been seen to draw with, and its meaning is unknown.

struct.name: TXSIZE
struct.doc: Log2 sizes of the base level and the detail level code. The diagnostic's mask is 23 bits. The client writes the width and height fields twice, in the low and high nibbles of each pair, with the same value.

struct.name: TXTILE
struct.doc: Written only by the client's texture-manager initialisation. The diagnostic's mask is 26 bits. Its meaning is unknown.

struct.name: TXLOD
struct.doc: Level-of-detail clamp. The minimum level is sent as the level times 64, with six fraction bits. The diagnostic's mask is 21 bits, so bits 25 to 21 of the client's word are outside the mask and their meaning is unknown.

struct.name: TXBCOLOR_RG
struct.doc: Texture border colour, red and green, 12 bits a component, laid out like the environment colour.

struct.name: TXBCOLOR_BA
struct.doc: Texture border colour, blue and alpha, 12 bits a component, laid out like the environment colour.

struct.name: TXBASE
struct.doc: Per-context base block in texture RAM. The client does not write it. The kernel's base write is inferred to land here.

struct.name: TRAM_CNTRL
struct.doc: Texture RAM control, 20 bits in the diagnostic's mask. Its meaning is unknown.

struct.name: MAX_PIXEL_RG
struct.doc: Maximum pixel clamp, red and green, 24 bits in the diagnostic's mask. The client writes it once in its texture-manager initialisation. Its meaning is unknown.

struct.name: MAX_PIXEL_BA
struct.doc: Maximum pixel clamp, blue and alpha, 24 bits in the diagnostic's mask. Its meaning is unknown.

struct.name: MDDMA_CNTRL
struct.doc: Multi-dimensional texture addressing, 29 bits in the diagnostic's mask. Used for volume and four-dimensional textures only. The field layout is fitted to a single volume load and is inferred.

struct.name: TEXRBUFFER
struct.doc: Texture read buffer select, one bit. The client writes it together with the complement in the loader's write-buffer register. The board's use is inferred from the register name.

struct.name: TXCLAMPSIZE
struct.doc: Clamp limits in texels: the base level's width and height without a border, shifted left by the first level. The client computes the word as the width shifted left 13 bits, OR'd with the height. The height field is 13 bits wide, so a height of 8192 reads back as zero.

struct.name: TE_RESET
struct.doc: Texture engine soft-reset strobe, 3 bits in the diagnostic's mask. The client does not write it.

struct.name: TXADDR
struct.doc: Index into the level tables. The client writes zero before it streams a table through the indexed-write token, and advances one entry per table write. The diagnostic's mask is 5 bits.

struct.name: TXDETAIL
struct.doc: First block of the detail texture, 9 bits in the diagnostic's mask.

struct.name: TXBORDER
struct.doc: Border block of each level, streamed through the level table with the index register. The diagnostic's mask is 9 bits.

struct.name: DETAILSCALE
struct.doc: Detail weight by level of detail: a 32-entry table of 6-bit values, filled through the indexed-write token. The client's default fills the table with 31, 31, 31, 29, 28 down to 1. The diagnostic's mask is 6 bits.

struct.name: TEVERS
struct.doc: Texture engine revision, 29 bits in the diagnostic's mask. The client does not write it. The diagnostic identifies revisions by a render checksum instead, see the checksum constants below.

struct.name: TL_WBUFFER
struct.doc: Texture loader write-buffer select, one bit. The client writes it with the complement of the read-buffer bit.

struct.name: TL_SPEC
struct.doc: Level being loaded: its number and its log2 width and height. The client sends the level's own size here, not the destination corners of the transfer.

struct.name: TL_MIPMAP
struct.doc: First block of a level, with a per-image flag bit. The diagnostic's mask is 9 bits. The client's copy path sends it; an ordinary load does not.

struct.name: TL_BORDER
struct.doc: Border block of a level, 9 bits in the diagnostic's mask.

struct.name: TL_VIDCNTRL
struct.doc: Video-to-texture capture start, one bit. The client does not write it; the kernel's video path does.

struct.name: TL_BASE
struct.doc: Base block of the texture being loaded, 8 bits in the diagnostic's mask.

struct.name: TL_S_SIZE
struct.doc: Copy rectangle width for a framebuffer copy, 14 bits in the diagnostic's mask.

struct.name: TL_T_SIZE
struct.doc: Copy rectangle height for a framebuffer copy, 14 bits in the diagnostic's mask.

struct.name: TL_S_LEFT
struct.doc: Copy rectangle left edge for a framebuffer copy, 14 bits in the diagnostic's mask.

struct.name: TL_T_BOTTOM
struct.doc: Copy rectangle bottom edge for a framebuffer copy, 14 bits in the diagnostic's mask.
